title: I turned my Bachelor thesis into a Steam game
author: SneakerHunterDev
selftext:
Most Bachelor theses end as a PDF that nobody ever reads again.
    
    
    I didn’t want that.
    
    
    So I used mine to build a fully playable game.
    
    
    My thesis was about an AI framework for generating game content via natural language. Instead of stopping after the academic part, I kept going and built a complete game on top of it as a proof of concept.
    
    
    The result is FLAIR, a game where AI is used to generate and evolve interactive content inside a shared world.
    
    
    What started as a uni project turned into:
    - a modular AI framework for game content generation
    - a full game built on top of it
    - a Steam page that reached around 20,000 visits surprisingly fast
    
    
    I decided to ship it as an actual product.
    
    
    FLAIR will be part of Steam Next Fest this February and released shortly after on Steam, iOS & Android.
    
    
    For me, this isn’t just a game.
    It’s a practical experiment in how natural language interfaces can enable new types of games and evolving digital worlds.
    
    
    If you’re curious, I’d really appreciate a wishlist. It helps a lot with visibility during Next Fest:
    
    
    Steam page:
    https://theflairgame.com/on-steam?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=bathesis&utm_content=aigamedev
    
    
    Happy to answer questions about the tech, the thesis, or the indie dev side of things.

comments.author: Trashy_io
comments.body:
Game sounds pretty amazing! Very ambitious! You have any videos of what your claims are? 

I saw your steam page but the video only shows pretty generic requests with heavy cuts. I would love to see more videos of the systems fully working before marketing. It wont do anyone any favors to make claims that are false and never come to fruition. 

I hope the best for you it sounds like an amazing project but my honest first impression as a person who would play this is: Sounds cool, looks alright currently, but the gameplay isn't as convincing as the description.

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Thank you so much for your Feedback! I really appreciate it! If you want to Play the Game own your own You Can do so already in the Alpha Tests and during steam Next fest Next month! If interested dm me!

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Also if you didn’t Like the Gameplay or You expected more, May I ask you what exactly could be improved? I‘m listening to every Feedback I get and I work everyday on the project so Looking forward for every Feedback :)

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body:
I just expected to see a playable game trailer very least if on steam. It doesn't look like a game at all really but a sand box that was thrown together without any of the systems actually working. Im not saying thats what it is but from first impressions thats what I am getting. 

I would love to help play test it out! I only say this because AI is getting a pretty bad reputation in the gaming industry for practices like I I stated.

Not saying you are guilty and even if you are its fine just learn and be more careful! 

So I guess the trailer is just off putting and could better represent the game

But the Trailer is actually Gameplay! (Except of the Audio, which was edited a Little). However thank you so much for the Feedback! 
If you want to playtest feel free to join the discord where I do the Testing rounds: https://discord.gg/SnTUKF5b8
